rationale: Three low-degree-of-freedom extensions proposed before inspecting full-pool baseline outcomes. These are hypotheses, not demonstrated 30-percent signals.
designSource: Independent methodology agent used existing source definitions only; no pilot, baseline or reserved-period outcome inspection.
execution: Reuse baseline single next-session opening attempt, costs, fixed quantity reserve, no stop and no fixed holding deadline; Top5 after filtering the full daily triggered set; keep original causal score and symbol tie-break.

candidates.extraFilter: Signal-day volume divided by the mean volume of the preceding 20 exchange sessions is at least 1.2; all 20 prior sessions must have known positive-volume bars.
candidates.hypothesis: Volume confirmation may reject weak price rebounds inside a trend.

candidates.extraFilter: The exact same default breakout condition was false on every one of the preceding 10 exchange sessions; each session must have enough complete causal indicator history. Today's base condition must pass.
candidates.hypothesis: A first trigger within ten sessions may avoid repeated late entries; it does not establish the start of a new bull trend.

candidates.extraFilter: The registered CSI300 benchmark has observed regime data and its signal-day close exceeds MA60, which exceeds the prior session's MA60. Missing benchmark observations produce no signal.
candidates.hypothesis: A rising broad market may improve momentum signal outcomes.

riskObservationOnly.policy: These are path diagnostics, not new stop orders or user risk tolerances. Entry-day risk is observed under T+1; target-open exit days exclude later lows. Intraday high/low same-bar ordering remains unknown.
riskObservationOnly.denominators: Keep complete potential follow-up cohorts, missing-result bounds and still-waiting events. Do not report only successful holding times.

validation: The 2024+ interval is not pristine: documented earlier six-stock runs exist. Additional historical tests need qualified provenance; independent validation requires frozen rules and separately justified untouched data or prospective observations.
